description: Find the zip codes of a place in Mexico. Asks the government registry for real and is billed to the connected account: see get_account for what it costs you. Only send identifiers the user gave you. Details: read_doc "geo/endpoints/geo-zip-search".

municipality.description: Letters found anywhere in the municipality's name.

settlement.description: Letters found anywhere in the settlement's name.

state.description: The state's name or how it starts (`Veracruz`). `Estado de México` and `CDMX` are understood. Narrows a search; cannot be sent alone.

zip.description: The first two to five digits of the zip code.

name: geo_zip_search
title: Find the zip codes of a place in Mexico
